panels.title: Rule staleness (seconds since last fire, ws4-detection only)
panels.description: M7 follow-up (2026-08-05, rule-health watchdog): a rule absent from this panel has never fired THIS PROCESS -- it is not yet distinguishable from 'never fired since deploy' vs. genuinely dead; that distinction is on the operator, same honesty caveat as this dashboard's other panels. A rule present and climbing is the real dead-rule signal this panel exists for.

panels.title: Bus errors (rate/s) -- bus unreachable, awaiting recovery
panels.description: Gap-hunt finding (2026-08-23): /metrics never surfaced the bus-connection failure class -- a worker whose bus host is down increments per-topic result="bus_error" (services/shared/runner.py::_topic_worker), but the old dashboard had no panel consuming it, so an operator saw only an absence of `acked` increments, indistinguishable from a genuinely idle topic. A non-flat line here (or the panel going non-empty) is the distinct early-warning signal; 0 is the healthy steady state.
